updates.race.title: RACE UPDATE
updates.race.description: New tracks have been added, including high-speed straights and competitive curves. Performance improvements and bug fixes ensure a smoother, more competitive racing experience.
updates.vehicle.title: VEHICLE SYSTEM
updates.vehicle.description: Enhanced vehicle physics and new customization options. Improved handling mechanics and expanded tuning capabilities for the ultimate racing experience.
updates.security.title: SECURITY UPDATE
updates.security.description: Enhanced anti-cheat system and improved server stability. New security measures to ensure fair play and better protection against exploits.
updates.ui.title: UI OVERHAUL
updates.ui.description: Complete redesign of the user interface with modern styling. Improved accessibility and responsive design for better user experience.
updates.newVehicles.title: NEW VEHICLES
updates.newVehicles.description: Added a variety of new vehicles including sports cars, motorcycles, and trucks. Each vehicle comes with unique handling characteristics and customization options.
updates.initial.title: INITIAL RELEASE
updates.initial.description: Welcome to our racing server! Experience thrilling races, competitive gameplay, and a vibrant community. Get ready to hit the tracks and show off your skills!
